title: Area-formula Jacobian of the polar map along a 2-plane containing the radial direction
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, Q and T linear subspaces of ℝ^P, and a, e, x ∈ ℝ^P with dim Q = 2, a, e ∈ Q, |a| = |e| = 1, ⟨a,e⟩ = 0, ⟨x,a⟩ > 0, dim T = 2 and p_T(x) = x (p_T := T.starProjection). Let F̃(y) := (|y|, arctan(⟨y,e⟩/⟨y,a⟩)) ∈ ℝ × ℝ, D := DF̃(x) (fderiv), (u_i)_{i < dim T} := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T, and Γ the dim T × dim T matrix Γ_ij := (Du_i)_1(Du_j)_1 + (Du_i)_2(Du_j)_2. Then sqrt(det Γ) = |p_T(⟨x,a⟩e − ⟨x,e⟩a)| / |Q.starProjection x|².
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e x : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < inner ℝ x a → Module.finrank ℝ T = 2 → T.starProjection x = x → Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ T) => (fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => (‖y‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a))) x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T i)).1 * (fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => (‖y‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a))) x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T j)).1 + (fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => (‖y‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a))) x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T i)).2 * (fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => (‖y‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a))) x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T j)).2)) = ‖T.starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2
